# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/gen_ucm_realm_actions.py; edit there, not this file.
can_keep_partition_succession_law_trigger = {
	OR = {
		var:ucm_law_lock_realm ?= flag:partition_succession_law
		AND = {
	
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_realm_law = partition_succession_law
		}
		OR = {
			can_have_partition_succession_law_trigger = yes

			
			has_title = title:e_mongol_empire
			has_title = title:e_ilkhanate
			has_title = title:e_golden_horde
			has_title = title:e_chagatai
			has_title = title:e_red_horde
			has_title = title:e_white_horde
			has_title = title:e_aarlud_khanate
			has_title = title:e_togskol_khanate
			has_title = title:e_baruun_khanate
			has_title = title:e_great_yuan
			has_title = title:e_blue_horde
			has_title = title:e_omnod_dalai_khanate
		}
	}
	NOT = { government_has_flag = government_is_clan }
}
	}
}

can_keep_single_heir_succession_law_trigger = {
	OR = {
		var:ucm_law_lock_realm ?= flag:single_heir_succession_law
		AND = {
	
	trigger_if = {
		limit = {
			has_realm_law = single_heir_succession_law
		}
		OR = {
			can_have_single_heir_succession_law_trigger = yes
			
			historical_succession_access_single_heir_succession_law_trigger = yes
			has_variable = purge_oath_previous_law 
		}
	}
}
	}
}

# Who a realm or gender law pick can apply to.
ucm_law_lock_can_gender_trigger = {
	is_ruler = yes
	is_landless_adventurer = no
	NOT = { has_government = administrative_government }
}

ucm_law_lock_can_realm_trigger = {
	ucm_law_lock_can_gender_trigger = yes
	OR = {
		government_has_flag = government_is_feudal
		government_has_flag = government_is_clan
		government_has_flag = government_is_tribal
	}
}

# The elective laws are player cheats: the AI can neither have nor pass them.
ucm_law_player_only_trigger = {
	ucm_single_player_trigger = yes
	is_ai = no
}
